organization_summary: YWAM Asheville is a discipleship community based in Asheville, North Carolina that operates as part of Youth With A Mission. The base runs Discipleship Training Schools (DTS), School of Ministry Development (SOMD), and engages in local outreach including anti-trafficking work and ministry to children at risk. YWAM organizational policy requires that ALL staff members raise 100% of their own personal support.
org_policy_note: YWAM Asheville staff members are required to raise their own funding as part of the broader YWAM organizational model. This meets the Tier A criteria under org_policy exception.

notes: YWAM Asheville operates as a discipleship base with staff requirements including completion of DTS and SOMD. Per YWAM organizational policy, all staff raise 100% of personal support, making this organization aligned with the donor prospect profile. However, roster development requires either: (1) direct contact with organization for staff directory, (2) identifying personal giving pages or prayer letters from individual staff members, or (3) discovering individual staff members through additional research channels not available through public web search.
